title: MidSideRouter — stage-level encode/decode, side high-pass
description:
Implement stage-level Mid/Side encode/decode performed ONCE around the parametric stages (not per-band), with configurable side high-pass per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §11.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §11.1–11.3 (M/S guitar-bus uses; side HPF 120–300 Hz; ShredWidth boundary — no delay-based width/decorrelation)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §19.1 (M/S processing adds 0 samples default latency)
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.* stereo routing notes from phase B (bands process L/R or mid/side samples the router supplies — do not add per-band M/S matrices)
- Sibling Source/DSP/* prepare/reset/process patterns (read only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h sideHighPass / M/S related IDs if present (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; h.5 owns registration)

Implement Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.h and Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.cpp:
1. MidSideRouter is the sole stage-level M/S matrix for parametric (and related) stages. encode once before the stage chain; decode once after. Document that ParametricBand must not embed its own encode/decode.
2. Encoding (stereo L/R → M/S): Mid = 0.5*(L+R), Side = 0.5*(L-R) (or project-consistent orthonormal scaling — document constant and keep encode/decode energy-preserving / inverse pair).
3. Decoding (M/S → L/R): exact inverse of encode. Mono input: pass-through; side path silent or zeroed as appropriate; no upmix.
4. Side high-pass: configurable cutoff in 120–300 Hz range (smoothed). Applies only to the Side channel after encode / before decode. True bypass of HPF when disabled or when M/S path inactive. Use modulation-stable 1st/2nd-order HPF consistent with existing project filters (TPT/biquad).
5. APIs: prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize), reset(), setEnabled(bool), setSideHighPassEnabled(bool), setSideHighPassHz(float clamped 120–300), processEncode(float* left, float* right, int numSamples) and processDecode(...) OR in-place process that takes a stage callback / buffer pair — prefer clear encode → external stage processing in caller's domain → decode so PluginProcessor (h.5) can wrap stages without the router owning ParametricBand.
6. Optional lightweight getters for whether current buffer is in M/S domain and current side HPF Hz for diagnostics.
7. Audio-thread safe: no heap, no locks, no allocations in process*; coefficient smoothing only; finite checks.
8. True bypass when router disabled: L/R unchanged (bit-identical or float-near-identical). Zero added latency.
9. No MonoGuard, SidechainAnalyzer, LookaheadDelay, PluginProcessor, tests, or CMakeLists changes in this task.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest.
acceptance_criteria: MidSideRouter performs stage-level encode once and decode once with inverse L/R↔M/S pair (no per-band matrix inside this module)
Side high-pass applies only to Side with cutoff clampable to 120–300 Hz and true bypass when disabled
processEncode/processDecode (or documented equivalent) paths are allocation-free and add zero samples of latency
Disabled/router-bypass leaves stereo L/R unchanged; mono layouts pass through safely
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement delay-based width, decorrelation, or artificial stereo (ShredWidth boundary)
add per-band M/S encode inside ParametricBand

allowed: 0.5*(L±R) or equivalent documented orthonormal M/S pair
reuse project TPT/biquad first-order or second-order HPF on Side only
separate encode/decode entry points so Processor wraps external stages
parameter smoothing on side HPF cutoff
forbidden: MonoGuard coherence analysis inside this module
